title.label: Avoid This App – Completely Useless Input Method

content.label:
This is a terrible app. The keyboard (input method) forces you to log in just to use it, but no matter which method I tried — Google, Email, or Apple ID — none of them worked. The network service is horribly unreliable, and the app is filled with tons of suspicious ad request links in the background.
I really don’t understand what the developers were thinking. A basic keyboard shouldn’t be this frustrating and intrusive. Total garbage. Do not download.
